title: I’m making a game in my city using Claude
author: Nandor89
selftext: I’m using free maps and a synty poligon asset pack to rebuild a sci version of my city in southern Italy, using real photos as references and filling it with characters inspired by real local people and funny stories. It’s an immersive sim, a parody of deus ex set in the intrigues of virtual hall. I’m only using human made assets, animations, sound packs, I have friends making music for me and I’m just generating placeholders like geometric shapes (a cone with a sphere for head and a stick for a Virgin Mary statue for example) and I plan to keep buying every asset I need. I have a question: would you play something like that?
